crossRefs.note: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his…
No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is…
or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

translations.web: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
translations.bsb: It is not in heaven, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
translations.kjv: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do
translations.asv: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, and make us to hear it, that we may do it?
